0022600021.text: The Houston Rockets (5-0, 1st in the Southwest and 1st in the West) visit the Dallas Mavericks (3-2, 4th in the Southwest and 7th in the West) in the sixth game of Houston's season, an Emirates NBA Cup West Group A matchup. Houston is missing Marcus Smart (out, forearm strain), Reed Sheppard (out, back) and Steven Adams (out, calf strain), and Alperen Sengun is day-to-day with back soreness and a game-time decision. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (out, foot surgery), Santi Aldama (out, knee surgery), Sergio de Larrea (out, knee strain) and Tarik Biberovic (out, heel inflammation), while Naji Marshall is day-to-day with an illness and a game-time decision. The Rockets lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 128-110 win in Houston on October 21, and the teams split their 2025-26 series 2-2.
